settings.playback.dts_passthrough.description: Playback preference title: send DTS audio unchanged to an external receiver.

settings.playback.dts_passthrough.copy.value: Send DTS and Dolby TrueHD soundtracks unchanged to an AV receiver or soundbar, which decodes them. On HDMI eARC/ARC, DTS-HD MA travels inside the TV's Dolby Digital Plus pass-through; TrueHD, DTS:X and high-bitrate DTS-HD MA also need the Atmos, TrueHD and DTS:X setting below. Otherwise, and on optical, DTS plays as its 5.1 core and TrueHD as Dolby Digital. Used only while the TV's sound goes to that output; set Digital Sound Output to Pass Through.

settings.playback.hbr_support.description: Playback preference title: install HBR (8-channel high-bitrate) audio support on a rooted TV.

settings.playback.hbr_support.copy.value: On a rooted TV with Homebrew Channel: installs a kernel module that lets the TV send 8-channel high-bitrate audio over HDMI eARC, for Dolby TrueHD and Atmos, DTS:X and full-rate DTS-HD MA. It is loaded again at every start. Tested on an LG C1 (webOS 6); other TVs refuse it safely.

settings.playback.hbr_support.installed.description: HBR audio support value: installed and loaded.

settings.playback.hbr_support.removed.description: HBR audio support value: not installed.
